privileged_info_for_vlm: There are 13 accounts that are incorrectly typed as 'Customer' because they lack 'Closed Won' opportunities (including Apple, Meta, ExxonMobil, Alphabet, Amazon, and NVIDIA). There are exactly 2 orphan contacts: Victor Huang and Laura Fischer. There is exactly 1 misattributed contact: James Chen (who has an @apple.com email but is assigned to Microsoft). The agent must change account types to something other than 'Customer' if no 'Closed Won' deal exists, and reassign contacts to accounts matching their email domains.
